content: अप्रकाश {%a.%} .²1 Not shining or bright, dark, wanting in brightness (<ab>fig.</ab> also); प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोक इवाचलः <ls>R. 1. 68</ls>. .²2 Self-illuminated. .²3 Hidden, secret, concealed; सीमायामप्रकाशानि कारयेत् <ls>Ms. 8. 251</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 256</ls>. .{@-शम्, -शे@} {%ind.%} In secret, secretly; अहमप्रकाशे तिष्ठामि <ls>M. 4</ls>; सत्यवत्या हस्तेऽप्रकाशं निक्षिप्तः <ls>V. 5</ls> secretly. .{@-शः@} Indistinctness, secrecy; a secret.
